perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Heating Up
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase accuracy and stability while improving vertical recoil.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.desc:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Transcendent Moment
perks.desc: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant stability and handling. Dark elements grant range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.

perks.name: Reservoir Burst
perks.desc: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.desc:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

perks.name: Vanguard Determination
perks.desc: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

perks.name: Veist Stinger
perks.desc: Damaging an enemy with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights. Bows receive faster draw speed and swords receive faster charge rate while this perk is active.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 153 from 9 September 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6iEksMDGzT5euNuMAEqnVm?si=a9bf49987cdb441a) with @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for sustained boss DPS in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. LFRs aren't currently the meta for boss damage at the time of writing but, if you're looking for one that's a featured Edge of Fate weapon, Boomslang-4fr is the only game in town. The weapon stats look decent compared to its peers - and that's helped further at Tier 4/5 when barrel and magazine perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/3926153598 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. At base, the battery holds 5 shots (max 6), and total ammo is 21. To keep the three-round burst on target, use the barrel perk to control recoil. For the battery perk, Enhanced Battery will maximise your shots or Accelerated Coils improves charge time and slightly increases DPS at the cost of less total damage. The trat perk set isn't ideal for boss damage, with no way to overflow the battery or passively refill it while shooting. In the first trait perk column, to help with reloads, Envious Arsenal refills the magazine from reserves on dealing damage with both of your other weapons (and bumps Ammo Generation by +20 when enhanced), Field Prep grants +50 Reload Speed with a ×0.8 animation scalar to both reload and ready/stow when crouched and bumps Ammo Generation by +30 (+55 Reload Speed and +40 Ammo Generation enhanced), or Rapid Hit stacks up to 5 times on crit hits for +25 Stability and +60 Reload Speed with a ×0.92 animation multiplier for a refreshable 2s. In the second column, for damage, Precision Instrument repeated crit hits grant escalating damage up to ×1.25 at 6 stacks (×1.3 when enhanced) for 1.25s or until you miss a crit. Alternatively, Jolting Feedback applies Jolt after 3 hits - the last shot of a single burst - to tougher enemies who can survive the weapon damage, triggering chain lightning on further hits for both target and AoE damage. The Vanguard Vindication Origin Trait provides up to 3 stacks of ×0.98/0.96/0.94 damage reduction for 10s, for kills within 20s of using a class ability. More usefully, Veist Stinger provides a 10% chance per hit to refill 25% of the battery. If you're interested, the boomslang is a highly venomous snake in the family Colubridae, native to Sub-Saharan Africa. Recommended MW: any, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
